title: Happy hour offer
description: Drive weekday traffic with a happy hour announcement and a copyable code. Seasonal campaign WhatsApp template for bars and restaurants.
notes: Send early afternoon on the day. Make the time window explicit so the offer is verifiably real.

body.text: Hi {{first_name}}, happy hour is on at {{restaurant}} from 5 to 7 PM. Show this code to get {{percent}}% off all drinks.
